papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.summary: FinBERT embeddings on 138k press releases (2005-2023). Press release sentiment as informative as earnings surprise for short-window returns. Uses full-open pricing at market open.
papers_found.relevance_note: Direct H174 upgrade — earlier signal (press release vs 8-K), same entry mechanics. H176 candidate.

papers_found.title: SAE-FiRE: Sparse Autoencoder Features for Earnings Surprise Prediction
papers_found.summary: Sparse autoencoders extract latent features from earnings transcripts/filings; 'significantly outperforms baseline' for earnings surprise prediction. No Sharpe reported.
papers_found.relevance_note: Could inform H260 (PEAD Revival ML features). Architecture is novel but no trading Sharpe to evaluate.

papers_found.title: Drift-Regime Conditional Factor (Value + Short-Term Reversal)
papers_found.summary: Drift gate: fraction positive days in trailing 63d > 0.60. Inside drift regime, value + short-term reversal signals activated. 20-year S&P 500 walk-forward Sharpe >13 (survivorship caveat). IMPORTANT: H265 tested momentum (different signal); H265b should test paper's actual value+reversal signals.
papers_found.relevance_note: H265 confirmed momentum version — H265b queued for paper's actual value+reversal signals with proper rolling universe.

papers_found.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers_found.summary: 15 fundamentals + 3 TA + FinBERT → Transformer. Direction prediction on earnings day. Transformer > LSTM in ablation. No aggregate Sharpe.
papers_found.relevance_note: Natural H174 evolution — multi-modal fusion. Suggests H177 (add numeric fundamentals to H174 scoring). No direct Sharpe to compare.

papers_found.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers_found.summary: DRL (PPO+LSTM) on Binance USD-M futures, 1-hour data. Multi-pair simultaneously. Significance only at 10% (not 5%) level.
papers_found.relevance_note: Crypto pairs DRL — not directly actionable. H246 pairs NOT CONFIRMED; weak statistical evidence here too.

papers_found.title: 3S-Trader: Multi-LLM Scoring/Strategy/Selection on DJIA
papers_found.summary: Three specialized LLM agents (scoring, strategy, selection) on DJIA. Accumulated return 131.83%, Sharpe 0.31, Calmar 11.84 (2024). Low Sharpe despite high return — volatile.
papers_found.relevance_note: Multi-agent architecture interesting but Sharpe 0.31 is well below production gate. Monitor space for improvements.

papers_found.title: HedgeAgents: Hedging-focused Multi-Agent LLM Framework
papers_found.summary: Multi-agent LLM for portfolio hedging decisions. General framework, no specific OOS Sharpe provided.
papers_found.relevance_note: Interesting for VRP/hedge overlay (H266 family) but too abstract for immediate use.
